precondition_sources.text: The validator private key is compromised (e.g., via phishing or insider attack).
The validator is the only entity capable of signing self-permits on behalf of users.
The owner has previously executed a self-permit so that allowance(owner, owner) > 0.

intent_sources.text: When msg.sender != owner, a third-party withdrawal or redemption must require explicit user approval rather than relying only on the owner's self-allowance.
